title: Construction of the scalar-extension tower
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ have topology $J$, and assume module sheafification in a fixed coefficient universe with its locally bijective characterization. Let $O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings, let $B:\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Sh}(J,\mathrm{CommRing})$, and let $\alpha:\operatorname{const}O\to B$. The SliceScalarTowerPresentation $O,B,\alpha$ of [def-sf-semilinear-slice-scalar-data] exists. Thus the actual scalar extensions $B_n\otimes_O H$ and the actual maps $\mathrm{id}\otimes f$ form an additive functor to strict systems, with transitions $b\otimes x\mapsto q(b)\otimes x$ and units $x\mapsto1\otimes x$, including their compatibility. No flatness or surjectivity assumption is required.

source.place: Tags 03DI (lemma-extension-by-zero), 03CY (lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules), 03EK (tensor product of module sheaves) and 0E8I (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor); the coefficient-generator refinement in lem-sf-semilinear-slice-scalar-generators.

proof.text: Choose the normalized scalar model for each alpha_n. Transpose its level-m unit through the level-n scalar adjunction and the identity-on-sections restriction compositor. The resulting transition sends b tensor x to q(b) tensor x. Identify the normalized model tensor with the actual sheafification unit pure tensor by linearity and cancellation of the prescribed object equality.

The generator extensionality theorem proves transition identity, composition and naturality from their unit-tensor formulas. Form the strict system and the functor with componentwise scalar-extension maps. Additivity is componentwise. The normalized units and preservation of one give the two unit formulas.
